SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.est_duration AS estDuration, p.applicant_count AS applicantCount, p.budget AS budget, c.company_name AS companyName, u.name AS clientName,
DATEDIFF(p.deadline_date, CURDATE()) AS dday,
CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_bookmarks pb WHERE pb.project_id = p.project_id AND pb.user_id = #{userId} ) END AS bookmarked FROM projects p
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = cp.company_id
WHERE p.is_public = TRUE AND p.project_status = 'READY'
AND p.created_at >= CURDATE() AND p.created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND p.deadline_date >= CURDATE() AND p.deadline_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 DAY)
AND p.deadline_date >= CURDATE()
AND (p.deadline_date < CURDATE() OR project_status = 'CLOSED')
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.project_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id) FROM projects p
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id
WHERE p.is_public = TRUE AND p.project_status = 'READY'
AND p.created_at >= CURDATE() AND p.created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND p.deadline_date >= CURDATE() AND p.deadline_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 DAY)
AND p.deadline_date < CURDATE()
AND p.deadline_date >= CURDATE()
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE project_status = 'READY' /* 모집 중인 건만 집계 (모집 종료된 건은 집계 제외) */ AND deadline_date >= CURDATE() AND deadline_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 DAY)

SELECT project_id, client_id, title, description, start_date, deadline_date, est_duration, budget, communicate_method, payment_method, change_policy, max_revision_count, project_status, is_public, created_at, updated_at, view_count, applicant_count FROM projects WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
